When I asked what the actual problem is, instead of helping, he behaved in a rude, arrogant, and disrespectful manner. His exact attitude was:

Seriously?? Is this how you treat a customer?

He even said that no one else can fix the phone except him and refused to explain anything. This feels like a clear tactic to make customers dependent on him so they are forced to keep coming back.

This is not customer service—this is manipulation and harassment. His behavior is extremely unprofessional, and talking to him is mentally draining.

I would strongly warn everyone:
DO NOT BUY ANYTHING FROM THIS SHOP.
You will end up wasting your time, money, and energy dealing with repeated issues and rude behavior.
